name: 79404 · Lubbock, TX
findings: ZIP 79404 (Lubbock) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79404 (Lubbock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79404 (Lubbock) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
